prior.text:
仅凭已有知识，我可以这样回答：

1. 编译时给 kernel 加行号信息：`nvcc -lineinfo`（或 `-G` 开全调试，但 `-G` 影响优化和时序，通常推荐 `-lineinfo`）。
2. 运行 sanitizer：
   ```
   compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./my_app
   ```
   memcheck 是默认工具。它会报告类似 `Invalid __global__ read of size 4`、出错线程的 `threadIdx`/`blockIdx`、访问地址，以及（有 `-lineinfo` 时）kernel 名和源文件:行号。
3. 其他常用选项（凭记忆，细节不确定）：
   - `--print-limit N` 控制打印的错误条数
   - `--error-exitcode 1`
   - `--destroy-on-device-error kernel`
   - `--save report.txt`
   - racecheck（shared memory 竞态）、initcheck（未初始化全局内存读）、synccheck（`__syncthreads` 非法使用）
4. 辅助手段：`CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` 让启动同步，便于定位出错 kernel；`cuda-gdb` 配合 `CUDA_DEVICE_WAITS_ON_EXCEPTION`；assert + `printf` 二分；越界常见原因是索引 `blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x` 未做 `if (i < n)` 边界检查。
5. 版本背景：CUDA 11.x（约 11.3 起）cuda-memcheck 被 compute-sanitizer 取代，CUDA 12 中只剩 compute-sanitizer。

不确定处：具体 flag 的准确拼写（如 `--print-limit`、`--error-exitcode` 的取值）、memcheck 输出的确切格式、compute-sanitizer 在哪个 CUDA 版本精确替代 cuda-memcheck、以及 `--generate-line-info` 与 `-lineinfo` 的细节，需要查官方文档核实。

# Memcheck Tool — Extracted Documentation

**Summary:** I've extracted all requested memcheck sections from the Compute Sanitizer v2026.3.0 documentation. One item — the CUDA version in which compute-sanitizer replaced cuda-memcheck — is **not mentioned anywhere in the provided content** (details at the end). The content also appears **truncated** at the end of the "Leak Checking in Compute Sanitizer" example (details at the end).

---

## 1. Exact Command Line Usage

General invocation:

```
compute-sanitizer [options] app_name [app_options]
```

Memcheck-specific usage (from "Using Memcheck"):

> The memcheck tool is enabled by default when running the Compute Sanitizer application. It can also be explicitly enabled by using the `--tool memcheck` option.

```
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck [sanitizer_options] app_name [app_options]
```

> When run in this way, the memcheck tool will look for precise, imprecise, malloc/free and CUDA API errors. The reporting of device leaks must be explicitly enabled. Errors identified by the memcheck tool are displayed on the screen after the application has completed execution.

---

## 2. How Out-of-Bounds / Misaligned Access Errors Are Reported

From "What is Memcheck?":

> The memcheck tool is a run time error detection tool for CUDA applications. The tool can precisely detect and report out of bounds and misaligned memory accesses to global, local and shared memory in CUDA applications. It can also detect and report hardware reported error information. In addition, the memcheck tool can detect and report memory leaks in the user application.

From Table 7 (Memcheck reported error types), the relevant entry:

| Name | Description | Location | Precision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Memory access error | Errors due to out of bounds or misaligned accesses to memory by a global, local, shared or global atomic access. | Device | Precise |

On precision:

> Precise errors in memcheck are those that the tool can uniquely identify and gather all information for. For these errors, memcheck can report the block and thread coordinates of the thread causing the failure, the program counter (PC) of the instruction performing the access, as well as the address being accessed and its size and type. If the CUDA application contains line number information (by either being compiled with device side debugging information, or with line information), then the tool will also print the source file and line number of the erroneous access.

### Example error report and line-by-line explanation (exact text)

```
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at unaligned_kernel():0x160 in memcheck_demo.cu:6
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x7f6510c00001 is misaligned
```

The documentation breaks down each line:

- **Line 1** — `Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes`: "The first line shows the memory segment, type and size being accessed. The memory segment is one of: `__global__` : for device global memory; `__shared__` : for per block shared memory; `__local__` : for per thread local memory. In this case, the access was to device global memory. The next field contains information about the type of access, whether it was a read or a write. In this case, the access is a write. Finally, the last item is the size of the access in bytes. In this example, the access was 4 bytes in size."
- **Line 2** — `at unaligned_kernel():0x160 in memcheck_demo.cu:6`: "The second line contains the CUDA kernel name, offset of the instruction, the source file and line number (if available). In this example, the instruction causing the access was at offset 0x160 inside the `unaligned_kernel` CUDA kernel. Additionally, since the application was compiled with line number information, this instruction corresponds to line 6 in the memcheck_demo.cu source file."
- **Line 3** — `by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)`: "The third line contains the thread indices and block indices of the thread on which the error was hit. In this example, the thread doing the erroneous access belonged to the first thread in the first block."
- **Line 4** — `Address 0x7f6510c00001 is misaligned`: "The fourth line contains the memory address being accessed and the type of access error. The type of access error can either be out of bounds access or misaligned access. In this example, the access was to address 0x7f6510c00001 and the access error was because this address was not aligned correctly."

---

## 3. Getting Source File and Line Number (Compilation Options)

From "Compilation Options" (exact text):

> The Compute Sanitizer tools do not need any special compilation flags to function.
>
> The output displayed by the Compute Sanitizer tools is more useful with some extra compiler flags. The `-G` option to nvcc forces the compiler to generate debug information for the CUDA application. To generate line number information for applications without affecting the optimization level of the output, the `-lineinfo` nvcc option can be used. The Compute Sanitizer tools fully support both of these options and can display source attribution of errors for applications compiled with line information.
>
> For memcheck specifically, the `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` option enables compile-time instrumentation, which provides significant performance improvements and enhanced error detection through base-and-bounds analysis. This flag instruments the code at compile time rather than at runtime.

Note included in the docs:

> **Note** — Option `-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` does not imply the generation of debug information. To get source attribution of errors, the application must also be compiled with `-lineinfo` or `-G`.

Sample build command lines given in the docs:

```
nvcc -Xcompiler -rdynamic -lineinfo  -o out in.cu
```

```
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo -o out in.cu
```

(The `-Xcompiler -rdynamic` flag on Linux, or `/Zi` on Windows, is needed for function names in **host** backtraces.)

---

## 4. Example Output Format (`memcheck_demo`)

### Release build (no line info)

Run command used:

```
$ make run_memcheck
/usr/local/cuda/compute-sanitizer/compute-sanitizer --destroy-on-device-error kernel memcheck_demo
```

Output:

```
========= COMPUTE-SANITIZER
Mallocing memory
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at unaligned_kernel()+0x50
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x710fdca00001 is misaligned
=========     and is inside the nearest allocation at 0x710fdca00000 of size 4 bytes
=========     Saved host backtrace up to driver entry point at kernel launch time
=========         Host Frame: run_unaligned() [0xacd4] in memcheck_demo
=========         Host Frame: main [0xae61] in memcheck_demo
=========
Running unaligned_kernel: no error
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at out_of_bounds_kernel()+0x90
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x87654320 is out of bounds
=========     and is 124,310,666,263,776 bytes before the nearest allocation at 0x710fdc800000 of size 1,024 bytes
=========     Saved host backtrace up to driver entry point at kernel launch time
=========         Host Frame: run_out_of_bounds() [0xadb6] in memcheck_demo
=========         Host Frame: main [0xae66] in memcheck_demo
=========
Running out_of_bounds_kernel: no error
========= ERROR SUMMARY: 2 errors
```

### Debug build (built via `make dbg=1`, adds line info)

```
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at unaligned_kernel()+0x100 in memcheck_demo.cu:34
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x7cc43aa00001 is misaligned
=========     and is inside the nearest allocation at 0x7cc43aa00000 of size 4 bytes
=========     Saved host backtrace up to driver entry point at kernel launch time
=========         Host Frame: run_unaligned() [0xacd4] in memcheck_demo
=========         Host Frame: main [0xae61] in memcheck_demo
```

Note the debug-build out-of-bounds report additionally shows a **device frame** backtrace:

```
=========     at out_of_bounds_function()+0xb0 in memcheck_demo.cu:39
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x87654320 is out of bounds
=========     and is 137,179,965,340,896 bytes before the nearest allocation at 0x7cc43a800000 of size 1,024 bytes
=========         Device Frame: out_of_bounds_kernel()+0x30 in memcheck_demo.cu:44
```

---

## 5. Requested Command-Line Options

### `--tool`
| Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| memcheck, racecheck, initcheck, synccheck | memcheck | Controls which Compute Sanitizer tool is actively running. |

### `--print-limit`
| Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| {number} | 100 | When this option is set, Compute Sanitizer will stop printing errors after reaching the given number of errors. Use 0 for unlimited printing. |

### `--error-exitcode`
| Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| {number} | 0 | The exit code Compute Sanitizer will return if the original application succeeded but the tool detected that errors were present. This is meant to allow Compute Sanitizer to be integrated into automated test suites. |

### `--destroy-on-device-error`
| Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| context, kernel | context | This controls how the application proceeds on hitting a memory access error. |

Supporting text from "Error Actions":

> Precise errors (such as memory access and malloc/free errors) detected by the memcheck tool cause the kernel to be terminated. This terminates the kernel without running any subsequent instructions and the application continues launching other kernels in the CUDA context. The handling of memory access and malloc/free errors detected by the memcheck tool can be changed using the `--destroy-on-device-error` option.

From Table 9 (Error Actions): Memory access error → action "Terminate CUDA context", comment "User can choose to instead terminate the kernel".

### `--save`
| Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| {filename} | N/A | Filename where Compute Sanitizer will save the output from the current run. For more information, see Escape Sequences. |

Escape sequences accepted by `--save` (and `--log-file`):

> - `%%` : Replaced with a literal %.
> - `%p` : Replaced with the PID of the Compute Sanitizer frontend application.
> - `%q{ENVVAR}` : Replaced with the contents of the environment variable `ENVVAR`. If the variable does not exist, this is replaced with an empty string.
> - Any other character following the % causes an error.

### Other memcheck-specific options (Table 3, for completeness)

| Option | Values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| check-cache-control | N/A | disabled | Check cache control memory accesses. |
| detect-missing-module-unload | N/A | disabled | Detect leaks caused by missing module unload calls. (May report false positives with the CUDA runtime.) |
| leak-check | full, no | no | Prints information about all allocations that have not been freed via cudaFree at the point when the context was destroyed. |
| padding | {number} | 0 | Makes the compute-sanitizer allocate padding buffers after every CUDA allocation. number is the size in bytes of a padding buffer. |
| report-api-errors | all, extended, explicit, no | extended | Reports errors if any CUDA API call fails. |
| report-device-side-allocation-failure | yes, no | yes | Enable warning generation on device side allocation failure. |
| track-stream-ordered-races | all, use-before-alloc, use-after-free, no | all | Track CUDA stream-ordered allocations races. |

---

<answer>

## 用 compute-sanitizer 定位 CUDA kernel 的 illegal memory access 越界行号

### 步骤 1：带行号信息重新编译

```
nvcc -lineinfo -o out in.cu
```

官方手册原文：`-lineinfo` 生成行号信息且不影响优化级别；`-G` 生成完整调试信息。注意：`-fdevice-sanitize=memcheck`（编译期插桩，性能更好）**不隐含**生成行号，仍需搭配 `-lineinfo` 或 `-G`。

```
nvcc -Xcompiler -rdynamic -lineinfo -o out in.cu        # 常规（-rdynamic 用于 host 回溯函数名）
nvcc -fdevice-sanitize=memcheck -lineinfo -o out in.cu  # 编译期插桩版本
```

### 步骤 2：运行 memcheck（默认工具）

```
compute-sanitizer --tool memcheck ./my_app
```

memcheck 是默认工具，`--tool memcheck` 可省略。它能精确检测 global/local/shared 内存的越界（out of bounds）和未对齐（misaligned）访问，属于 "Precise" 错误：会报告出错的 block/thread 坐标、指令 PC、被访问地址、大小和类型；编译带行号信息时还会打印源文件和行号。

### 步骤 3：解读输出，直接看行号

典型报告（官方示例）：

```
========= Invalid __global__ write of size 4 bytes
=========     at out_of_bounds_kernel()+0x90 in memcheck_demo.cu:39
=========     by thread (0,0,0) in block (0,0,0)
=========     Address 0x87654320 is out of bounds
=========     and is ... bytes before the nearest allocation at 0x7cc43a800000 of size 1,024 bytes
```

- 第 1 行：内存段（`__global__`/`__shared__`/`__local__`）、读/写、字节数
- 第 2 行：kernel 名 + 指令偏移 + **源文件:行号**（即越界那一行）
- 第 3 行：出错线程的 thread/block 索引
- 第 4 行：出错地址及错误类型（out of bounds / misaligned），并给出最近分配的基址和大小，可判断越界方向和距离

### 常用选项（来自官方选项表）

| 选项 | 默认值 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `--tool {memcheck,racecheck,initcheck,synccheck}` | memcheck | 选择工具；shared memory 竞态用 racecheck，未初始化全局读用 initcheck，`__syncthreads` 非法用 synccheck |
| `--print-limit {N}` | 100 | 打满 N 条后停止打印，0 = 不限 |
| `--error-exitcode {N}` | 0 | 检测到错误时的退出码（接 CI） |
| `--destroy-on-device-error {context,kernel}` | context | 出错时终止 context 还是仅终止 kernel |
| `--save {filename}` | — | 把输出保存到文件（支持 `%p` PID、`%q{VAR}` 转义） |
| `--leak-check {full,no}` | no | 报告未 `cudaFree` 的分配 |

### 版本与注意

- 目标工具即 CUDA Toolkit 自带的 `compute-sanitizer`（文档版本 v2026.3.0），随 CUDA 安装，无额外版本选择负担；本次抓取的官方页面未说明它在哪个 CUDA 版本取代 cuda-memcheck（未核实，检索结果 #5 的 CUDA Toolkit 文档页也未抓取确认，通常说法是 CUDA 11 起替代，此处标注为未核实）。
- sanitizer 会显著拖慢 kernel，属正常；`--fdevice-sanitize=memcheck` 编译期插桩可降低开销。
- 若只在某个 kernel 报错而定位不到，可先用 `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 ./my_app` 同步启动缩小范围，再交给 compute-sanitizer。
- 越界最常见根因：`i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x + threadIdx.x` 缺 `if (i < n)` 边界判断，或 shared/local 数组下标越界。

### 来源

- 官方手册（memcheck 用法、编译选项、输出示例、选项表均出自此）：https://docs.nvidia.com/compute-sanitizer/ComputeSanitizer/index.html
- CUDA Toolkit 文档镜像页（检索命中，未抓取）：https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/compute-sanitizer/index.html
- NVIDIA 开发者博客（中文，检索命中，未抓取）：https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/efficient-cuda-debugging-memory-initialization-and-thread-synchronization-with-nvidia-compute-sanitizer/
- 第三方示例（检索命中，未抓取）：CSDN、腾讯云社区若干文章

未核实处：compute-sanitizer 精确替代 cuda-memcheck 的 CUDA 版本号（官方手册正文未提及）；未实际运行任何命令（环境无此操作）。
</answer>
